ui.devtools.click-a-row-to-see-details: Click a row to see its input, output, and timing.
ui.devtools.content-truncated: Content is too long; only the first part is shown.
ui.devtools.diagnostic-logs-are-off: Diagnostic logs are off, so process I/O was not recorded. Turn them on in Settings → Privacy & Permissions; later turns will be recorded.
ui.devtools.evidence-burst: Upstream may have buffered output and sent it all at once
ui.devtools.evidence-converted-note: Gateway converted wire protocol ({0} → {1}); some native signals may be translated
ui.devtools.evidence-fallback: Request retried/fell back across {0} upstream attempts
ui.devtools.evidence-header-conflict: Header {0} indicates {1}, conflicting with expected vendor {2}
ui.devtools.evidence-id-suspect: Response ID ({0}) differs from typical {1} format; may be rewritten or served by another backend
ui.devtools.evidence-model-alias: Response model {1} is a dated provider alias of requested {0}
ui.devtools.evidence-model-family-mismat: Returned model is a different version of the same series: requested {0}, upstream returned {1}; versions are not identical
ui.devtools.evidence-model-history-diff: Historical turn shows a model difference from the reply record only: requested {0}, reply recorded {1} (no headers or fingerprint evidence)
ui.devtools.evidence-model-absent: Upstream response did not report a model name
ui.devtools.evidence-model-cross-vendor: Suspected cross-vendor substitution: requested {0} ({1}), upstream returned {2} ({3})
ui.devtools.evidence-model-mismatch: Returned model mismatch: requested {0}, upstream returned {1}
ui.devtools.evidence-sig-missing: Reasoning text seen on passthrough without native encrypted signature
ui.devtools.evidence-sysfp-conflict: system_fingerprint ({0}) contains {1} token, conflicting with expected vendor {2}
ui.devtools.inspector-placeholder: Select any step from the graph, timeline, or thinking flow to inspect arguments, outputs, diffs, and full reasoning.
ui.devtools.no-body-recorded-for-this-re: No body for this request: bodies are recorded only while diagnostic logs are on, and kept for 24 hours.
ui.devtools.no-gateway-requests-in-this-: No gateway model requests in this turn.
ui.devtools.no-gateway-requests-official: No gateway model requests in this turn (with an official account, the agent connects to the official service directly).
ui.devtools.no-input-or-output-was-kept: No input or output was kept for this call (older messages keep only an outline).
ui.devtools.no-model-audit-data: No gateway requests or model metadata recorded in this trace; fingerprint verification is available for gateway-routed or model-tagged sessions.
ui.devtools.no-process-records-in-this-t: No process records in this turn.
ui.devtools.no-steps-in-this-turn: No thinking, tool calls, or gateway requests in this turn.
ui.devtools.no-thinking-steps: No thinking steps recorded in this scope.
ui.devtools.search-placeholder: Search thinking, tools, commands, paths, outputs, or errors…
ui.devtools.subagent-closed-hint: Subagent tab was closed; showing invocation and final report summary only.
